# About City Property Services

Source: https://cityprop.co.in/about-us/

City Property Services is a trusted Ahmedabad real estate consultancy. We help people and businesses buy, sell, lease, rent and invest in the right properties, with honest advice and steady support from the first conversation to the final handover.

## Our story

We have spent many years helping clients across Ahmedabad and Gujarat make sound property decisions. In that time the city has grown a lot, and so has the kind of help people need, from a first family home to a corporate office, a warehouse or a long term investment.

Our work is led by Mr. Mukesh Vasani, whose experience and steady judgement shape how we treat every client. He is also one of the founders of CIRIL, a commercial real estate network that works in more than thirty cities across India. That wider reach sits quietly behind the local, personal service you get from our team here in Ahmedabad.

We are proud of the relationships we have built over the years. A lot of our work comes from clients who return to us, and from the people they refer, which is the kind of trust we try to earn every single day.

## What we help with

We cover the full range of property needs in and around Ahmedabad:

- Corporate offices
- Retail spaces
- Warehouses
- Industrial land
- Residential properties
- Plots
- Investment properties
- Preleased properties
- Prelaunched projects

## Why clients choose us

- **Local Ahmedabad knowledge** — We know the city pocket by pocket, so our advice is grounded in how each area really lives and trades.
- **Access to quality properties** — Years of relationships mean we often hear about the right property before it is widely listed.
- **Transparent guidance** — You get honest pros and cons, fair pricing and clear next steps, never pressure.
- **Support from search to closing** — We stay with you through visits, negotiation, paperwork and final handover.
- **Residential and commercial expertise** — Homes, offices, retail, industrial and land, all under one roof.
- **Long term relationships** — We would rather earn a client for life than push a single deal.

## Our vision

We want City Property Services to be the name people in Ahmedabad trust first when it comes to property. Not because we are the loudest, but because we are dependable, professional and genuinely useful.

Our aim is simple. Give clear, practical guidance, treat every client with respect, and help people build long term value through the right property decisions. When you do well, we do well, and that is exactly how we like it.

# The Ahmedabad Buyer & Seller Guide

Source: https://cityprop.co.in/guide/

Buying or selling a property can feel confusing, with RERA, title checks, stamp duty and possession to navigate. We’ve broken the whole process down into clear, friendly steps for both buyers and sellers in Ahmedabad.

## Buyer's Guide for Ahmedabad (13 steps)

Your step by step path from “maybe” to keys in hand, without nasty surprises.

1. **Understand your budget & loan eligibility** — Work out what you can comfortably spend, including a buffer. Get a loan pre-approval so you know your real range before you fall in love with a place.
2. **Choose localities that fit your life** — Weigh commute, schools, daily needs, future growth and price. SG Highway, Satellite, Bopal, Shela and Gota all feel very different, so pick what suits you.
3. **Shortlist properties** — Narrow to a handful that match your budget, size and locality. Quality over quantity saves a lot of running around.
4. **Visit and compare** — See them in person, ideally at different times of day. Check light, water, parking, noise and the neighbours.
5. **Check RERA registration** — For under-construction and many new projects, confirm the RERA number on the Gujarat RERA site. It protects you.
6. **Verify title & legal documents** — Confirm clear title, ownership, approved plans, NOC and society dues. A lawyer’s title check is money well spent.
7. **Negotiate price and terms** — Negotiate on price, payment schedule, what stays in the home, and the possession date, not just the number.
8. **Pay the token amount** — Only after basic verification, pay a token to hold the property, with a simple written receipt and agreed timeline.
9. **Sign the sale agreement** — A clear agreement records price, payment plan, possession date and penalties. Read it carefully before signing.
10. **Complete the home loan process** — If you’re taking a loan, submit documents, get the valuation done, and align disbursement with your payment schedule.
11. **Pay stamp duty & register** — Pay stamp duty and registration charges and register the sale deed at the sub-registrar office.
12. **Final payment & possession** — Make the final payment, collect keys, and do a joint handover check of the property.
13. **Transfer utilities & society handover** — Transfer electricity, gas, and the society membership into your name, and collect all documents.

## Seller's Guide for Ahmedabad (12 steps)

How to sell at a fair price, to the right buyer, with the paperwork done properly.

1. **Estimate the current market value** — Start with a realistic, evidence-based price using recent deals in your locality, not an aspirational number.
2. **Prepare your documents** — Gather title deed, approved plans, tax receipts, society NOC and any loan papers up front to avoid delays later.
3. **Decide your price & negotiation range** — Set an asking price and the lowest you’ll accept, so you can negotiate calmly and confidently.
4. **Improve presentation** — Declutter, fix the small stuff, and clean thoroughly. First impressions move price and speed.
5. **Professional photos & listing** — Good photos and an honest, detailed listing bring more, and more serious, enquiries.
6. **Screen buyers** — Focus your time on genuine, financially-ready buyers instead of casual lookers.
7. **Site visits** — Host visits at convenient times and be ready to answer questions about the home and the area.
8. **Negotiate the price** — Negotiate on price and terms, keeping your walk-away number in mind.
9. **Token & agreement** — Accept a token with a written agreement covering price, timeline and conditions.
10. **Legal verification** — Let the buyer’s side verify documents, and being ready here keeps the deal moving.
11. **Register the sale deed** — Execute and register the sale deed, with stamp duty and registration handled correctly.
12. **Final payment & handover** — Collect the final payment, hand over keys and documents, and transfer utilities and society membership.
